newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products - gas oil up, fuel oil down.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - gas oil up, fuel oil down.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Tuesday, gas oil firmer with futures and fuel oil down on the day while pulled in opposite directions, dealers said.
High sulphur fuel oil barges traded in the range $84-$86 fob Rotterdam, albeit for different grades and timings. This left them about $1 down from Monday's close.

One major bought prompt refinery material a number of times at $86 fob, while a trading house sold stored product for delivery after June 20 at $84 and $84.50. The same trading house was also reported to be still having difficulties supplying prompt product.
"It was all supposed to be over at the weekend. They're not able to perform until tomorrow afternoon now," one trader said.
A number of traders said the major and the trading house were competing to steer the market in directions that would suit their positions.

Gasoline barges were steady to firm in what remained a two-tier market. One ARA eurograde barge sold at $192 fob. AR material was offered at $194, while prompt Rotterdam product offers were as high as $198.
July and August swaps were slightly firmer as futures gained.
Heating oil barges were about $1 a tonne firmer as IPE July gas oil futures strengthened. Prompt material remained valued at around IPE July flat and demand was still poor.
